mapper.select: SELECT g.goods_id, g.goods_name, g.goods_img, g.goods_number, g.is_on_sale, g.status, g.is_delete, g.is_virtual, g.min_sales_num, g.sales_step_width, g.share_stock_id, s.goods_number AS shared_stock, s.is_on_sale AS shared_on_sale, d.arrival_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dodo_shop_goods sg WHERE sg.goods_id = g.goods_id AND sg.shop_id = #{shopId} AND sg.status = 1) AS in_shop FROM dodo_goods g LEFT JOIN dodo_goods_share_stock s ON s.id = g.share_stock_id AND s.status = 1 LEFT JOIN dodo_goods_delay d ON d.id = g.delay_id AND d.store_id = g.store_id AND d.status = 1 AND d.delay_status = 1 WHERE g.store_id = #{storeId} AND g.goods_id IN #{goodsId}
SELECT dict_value FROM dodo_dict WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND dict_type = 'dispatch_time' AND dict_key = 'days' AND status = 1 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dodo_order_info o JOIN dodo_order_goods g ON g.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.store_id = #{storeId} AND o.shop_id = #{shopId} AND o.status = 1 AND o.pay_status = 3 AND o.order_status <> 5 AND o.create_time >= #{subscribedAt} AND g.goods_id = #{goodsId} AND g.status = 1 AND g.goods_number > 0
SELECT client_id, is_subscribe_msg, is_open_push FROM dodo_users WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dodo_operate_log (store_id, operate_user_id, operate_user_name, operate_type, operate_content, create_time) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{actorId}, (SELECT name FROM dodo_admin_user WHERE user_id = #{actorId}), '补货提醒', #{content}, #{createdAt})
